title: Orsen and the Thorn
author: Theo Okafor
blurb: Jude Sandoval, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
